verdict.rationale: Requesty offers an explicit EU-routing option (Frankfurt, AWS eu-central-1) keeping processing and storage within the EU, giving users some data-residency choice. However, evidence only shows one alternative region (EU vs default), not a broader set of selectable regions/residency options. Missing for 10: documentation of additional region choices (e.g., US-only, APAC), enterprise data-residency controls, and independent verification of enforcement.
